name: match_recognize
description: Internal window function implementing row pattern matching for MATCH_RECOGNIZE
example: MATCH_RECOGNIZE(PATTERN (A B) DEFINE A AS x > 0, B AS y > 0)

name: non_overlap_intervals
description: Internal window function selecting the non-overlapping intervals of a partition
example: non_overlap_intervals(match_start, match_end, false) OVER (PARTITION BY p)
